title: Global loading/error components + app-wide spacing and consistency polish

requirements.summary: Add shared loading UI components (full-page + inline) and replace ad-hoc loaders across core app screens/components.
acceptanceCriteria: A shared loading component (or small set of shared components for full-page vs. inline loading) exists in the frontend codebase and is used by the main app authentication/loading gate and the primary pages.
Loading UI uses consistent styling (typography, spacing, spinner sizing/colors) across all locations where it appears.
No user-facing loading text is left inconsistent (e.g., a mix of 'Loading...' and differently styled loading labels) unless intentionally parameterized via props.

file_operations.description: Create reusable loading UI components (e.g., FullPageLoading and InlineLoading) that standardize spinner sizing/colors, spacing, and optional message handling via props.
Replace the AuthGate full-screen loader with the shared FullPageLoading component, ensuring the loading message is consistently styled/parameterized.
Replace the page-level loading card spinner/text with the shared loading UI (likely InlineLoading within CardContent or a shared pattern) to match global styling. Do not change empty states.
Replace the current page loading block with the shared loading UI to standardize spinner and message presentation. Do not change empty state UI.
Replace the initial admin-role loading block (and any other ad-hoc spinners in the page where appropriate) with the shared loading UI pattern while preserving admin gating and existing behavior.
Replace the chat loading spinner/text with the shared inline loading UI to standardize loading appearance. Do not change the chat empty state.

requirements.summary: Add a shared error UI component (with optional retry) and replace ad-hoc error rendering across key screens/components.
acceptanceCriteria: A shared error component exists and supports at least: title, message, and an optional retry callback.
At least the main pages and key data components that currently render errors (e.g., match history) use the shared error UI.
User-facing error text is in English and follows a consistent tone and structure across the app.

file_operations.description: Create a reusable error UI component that supports title, message, and an optional retry action callback, with consistent iconography/typography/spacing.
Replace the current inline destructive error text with the shared ErrorState component, keeping the existing empty state behavior unchanged.

Add/standardize error rendering using ErrorState for leaderboard-related failures where errors are currently surfaced inconsistently (while preserving existing toast usage and not altering empty states).
Add/standardize error rendering for message load/send failures using the shared ErrorState pattern where appropriate, without changing the existing empty state UI.

requirements.summary: Standardize page wrappers, headers, and spacing across pages/layouts for a more uniform polished UI without changing functionality.
acceptanceCriteria: All top-level pages use a consistent page wrapper approach (consistent max width, horizontal padding behavior, and vertical spacing between sections).
Headings and icon+heading rows (e.g., 'Calendar', 'Leaderboard', 'Profile') follow consistent sizing, spacing, and alignment across pages.
Card sections (CardHeader/CardContent) and common interactive rows use consistent padding and gap spacing across pages.
No functionality regressions: navigation, forms, leaderboard actions, chat, and profile flows still work as before.

file_operations.description: Create shared layout primitives for consistent page structure (e.g., Page container wrapper and a PageHeader component supporting optional icon + title + right-side actions) to unify max-width and spacing.
Align the main content wrapper spacing defaults (container/padding/vertical rhythm) with the new PageLayout approach, without changing routing or overall layout structure.

Adopt the shared PageLayout/PageHeader for consistent header styling and section spacing; ensure the primary action button alignment matches other pages. Keep existing functionality and do not change empty states.
Adopt the shared PageLayout/PageHeader for consistent max-width and heading row alignment (icon + title), and normalize section spacing/card padding where needed without altering behavior.
Adopt the shared PageLayout/PageHeader for consistent max-width and heading row alignment (icon + title), and normalize spacing between ProfileCard and subsequent cards.
Adopt the shared PageLayout/PageHeader for consistent header row alignment and page spacing; normalize form section spacing/button row alignment while keeping form behavior unchanged.
Adopt the shared PageLayout/PageHeader for consistent header row (back button + title) alignment and page spacing; keep existing empty state and actions unchanged.
Adopt the shared PageLayout/PageHeader for consistent max-width and heading spacing, while preserving the existing height constraints and chat functionality.
Adopt the shared PageLayout/PageHeader for consistent admin page heading and section spacing, while preserving admin guard logic and table behaviors.
